title: 22 Years of Dating Advice Summarized in 11 Minutes
transcript_head: From 2008 to 2013, I was a professional dating and relationships coach. I happened to write one of the best -selling dating advice books ever written. And, oh, that's right, I've been married for 10 years, very happily. Here's everything I know about dating advice summarized in the next 10 minutes. Number one, if it's not a fuck yes, then it isn't no. So much time and energy is wasted in ambiguity and uncertainty. We spend so much of our energy trying to convince somebody who doesn't like us to like us, or trying to convince ourselves to like somebody that we don't actually like. The truth is that our time and energy is better spent trying to find somebody that you both feel fuck yes about each other, rather than trying to convince yourself or them to feel fuck yes in the first place. In my opinion, in 2026, dating is largely a time management issue. And fuck yes or no is one of the most useful tools to manage that time.
